       handle (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           handle to the hipSPARSE library context queue.

       opA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`A` operation type.

       opB (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`B` operation type.

       alpha (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\alpha`.

       matA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`A` descriptor.

       matB (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`B` descriptor.

       beta (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\beta`.

       matC (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *OUT*:
           sparse matrix :math:`C` descriptor.

       computeType (:py:obj:`~.hipDataType`) -- *IN*:
           floating point precision for the SpGEMM computation.

       alg (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpGEMMAlg_t`) -- *IN*:
           SpGEMM algorithm for the SpGEMM computation.

       spgemmDescr (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpGEMMDescr`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           SpGEMM descriptor.

       bufferSize1 (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.PointerToUInt64`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *OUT*:
           number of bytes of the temporary storage buffer.

       externalBuffer1 (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           temporary storage buffer allocated by the user.

   Returns:
       A :py:obj:`~.tuple` of size 1 that contains (in that order):

       * :py:obj:`~.hipsparseStatus_t`: One of:
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_SUCCESS`: the operation completed successfully.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED`: ``handle`` is not initialized.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE`: ``handle,`` ``alpha,`` ``beta,`` ``matA,`` ``matB,`` ``matC,``

               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED`: additional buffer for long rows could not be allocated.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED`: ``opA`` != ``HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`` or
                 ``opB`` != ``HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`` .

.. py:function:: hipsparseSpGEMM_compute(handle, opA, opB, alpha, matA, matB, beta, matC, computeType, alg, spgemmDescr, bufferSize2, externalBuffer2)

   Compute step of the sparse matrix sparse matrix product:

   .. math::

      C' := \alpha \cdot op(A) \cdot op(B) + \beta \cdot C,

   ``hipsparseSpGEMM_compute`` is called twice, first to compute the size of the second required user-allocated
   buffer. After this buffer size is determined, the user allocates it and calls ``hipsparseSpGEMM_compute``
   a second time with the newly allocated buffer passed in. This second call performs the actual computation
   of :math:`C' = \alpha \cdot A \cdot B` (the result is stored in the temporary buffers).

   ``hipsparseSpGEMM_compute`` supports multiple combinations of data types and compute types. See ``hipsparseSpGEMM_copy`` 
   for a complete listing of all the data type and compute type combinations available.

   Par:

   .. code-block::

      void*  dBuffer2  = NULL;
      size_t bufferSize2 = 0;

      size_t bufferSize2 = 0;
      hipsparseSpGEMM_compute(handle, opA, opB,
                              &alpha, matA, matB, &beta, matC,
                              computeType, HIPSPARSE_SPGEMM_DEFAULT,
                              spgemmDesc, &bufferSize2, NULL);
      hipMalloc((void**) &dBuffer2, bufferSize2);

      // compute the intermediate product of A * B
      hipsparseSpGEMM_compute(handle, opA, opB,
                              &alpha, matA, matB, &beta, matC,
                              computeType, HIPSPARSE_SPGEMM_DEFAULT,
                              spgemmDesc, &bufferSize2, dBuffer2);

   Args:
       handle (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           handle to the hipSPARSE library context queue.

           sparse matrix :math:`A` operation type.

       opB (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`B` operation type.

       alpha (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\alpha`.

       matA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`A` descriptor.

       matB (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`B` descriptor.

       beta (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\beta`.

       matC (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *OUT*:
           sparse matrix :math:`C` descriptor.

       computeType (:py:obj:`~.hipDataType`) -- *IN*:
           floating point precision for the SpGEMM computation.

       alg (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpGEMMAlg_t`) -- *IN*:
           SpGEMM algorithm for the SpGEMM computation.

       spgemmDescr (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpGEMMDescr`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           SpGEMM descriptor.

       bufferSize2 (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.PointerToUInt64`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *OUT*:
           number of bytes of the temporary storage buffer.

       externalBuffer2 (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           temporary storage buffer allocated by the user.

   Returns:
       A :py:obj:`~.tuple` of size 1 that contains (in that order):

       * :py:obj:`~.hipsparseStatus_t`: One of:
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_SUCCESS`: the operation completed successfully.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE`: ``handle,`` ``alpha,`` ``beta,`` ``matA,`` ``matB,`` ``matC,``
                 or ``bufferSize2`` pointer is invalid.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED`: additional buffer for long rows could not be
                 allocated.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED`: ``opA`` != ``HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`` or
                 ``opB`` != ``HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`` .

.. py:function:: hipsparseSpGEMM_copy(handle, opA, opB, alpha, matA, matB, beta, matC, computeType, alg, spgemmDescr)

   Copy step of the sparse matrix sparse matrix product:

   .. math::

      C' := \alpha \cdot op(A) \cdot op(B) + \beta \cdot C,

   ``hipsparseSpGEMM_copy`` is called once to copy the results (that are currently stored in the temporary arrays)
   to the output sparse matrix. If :math:`\beta != 0`, then the :math:`beta \cdot C` portion of the computation:
   :math:`C' = \alpha \cdot A \cdot B + \beta * C` is handled. This is possible because :math:`C'` and :math:`C` must have
   the same sparsity pattern.

   ``hipsparseSpGEMM_copy`` supports multiple combinations of data types and compute types. The tables below indicate the currently
   supported different data types that can be used for the sparse matrices :math:`op(A)`, :math:`op(B)`, :math:`C`, and :math:`C'`
   and the compute type for :math:`\alpha` and :math:`\beta`. The advantage of using different data types is to save on
   memory bandwidth and storage when a user application supports it, while performing the actual computation in a higher precision.

   Par:
       <table>
       <caption id="spgemm_copy_uniform">Uniform Precisions</caption>
       <tr><th>A / B / C / C' / compute_type
       <tr><td>HIP_R_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_R_64F
       <tr><td>HIP_C_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_C_64F
       </table>

   ``hipsparseSpGEMM_copy`` supports ``HIPSPARSE_INDEX_32I`` and ``HIPSPARSE_INDEX_64I`` index precisions
   for storing the row pointer and row/column indices arrays of the sparse matrices.

   Note:
       The two user allocated temporary buffers can only be freed after the call to ``hipsparseSpGEMM_copy``

   Args:
       handle (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           handle to the hipSPARSE library context queue.

       opA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`A` operation type.

       opB (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`B` operation type.

       alpha (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\alpha`.

       matA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`A` descriptor.

       matB (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix :math:`B` descriptor.

       beta (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\beta`.

       matC (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *OUT*:
           sparse matrix :math:`C` descriptor.

       computeType (:py:obj:`~.hipDataType`) -- *IN*:
           floating point precision for the SpGEMM computation.

       alg (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpGEMMAlg_t`) -- *IN*:
           SpGEMM algorithm for the SpGEMM computation.

       spgemmDescr (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpGEMMDescr`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           SpGEMM descriptor.

   Returns:
       A :py:obj:`~.tuple` of size 1 that contains (in that order):

       * :py:obj:`~.hipsparseStatus_t`: One of:
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_SUCCESS`: the operation completed successfully.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE`: ``handle,`` ``alpha,`` ``beta,`` ``matA,`` ``matB,`` or ``matC`` pointer is invalid.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED`: additional buffer for long rows could not be
                 allocated.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED`: ``opA`` != ``HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`` or
                 ``opB`` != ``HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`` .

   .. rubric:: C signature

   .. code-block:: c

.. py:function:: hipsparseSpGEMMreuse_copy(handle, opA, opB, matA, matB, matC, alg, spgemmDescr, bufferSize5, externalBuffer5)

   Copy step of the sparse matrix sparse matrix product:

   .. math::

      C' := \alpha \cdot op(A) \cdot op(B) + \beta \cdot C,

   Par:

   .. code-block::

      // Get matrix C non-zero entries nnzC
      int64_t rowsC, colsC, nnzC;
      hipsparseSpMatGetSize(matC, &rowsC, &colsC, &nnzC);

      // Allocate matrix C
      hipMalloc((void**) &dcsrColIndC, sizeof(int) * nnzC);
      hipMalloc((void**) &dcsrValC,  sizeof(float) * nnzC);

      // Update matC with the new pointers. The C values array can be filled with data here
      // which is used if beta != 0.
      hipsparseCsrSetPointers(matC, dcsrRowPtrC, dcsrColIndC, dcsrValC);

      // Determine size of fifth user allocated buffer
      hipsparseSpGEMMreuse_copy(handle, opA, opB, matA, matB, matC,
                                   HIPSPARSE_SPGEMM_DEFAULT, spgemmDesc,
                                   &bufferSize5, NULL);

      hipMalloc((void**) &dBuffer5, bufferSize5);

      // Copy data from temporary buffers to the newly allocated C matrix
      hipsparseSpGEMMreuse_copy(handle, opA, opB, matA, matB, matC,
                                   HIPSPARSE_SPGEMM_DEFAULT, spgemmDesc,
                                   &bufferSize5, dBuffer5);

      // We can now free buffer 3
      hipFree(dBuffer3);

.. py:function:: hipsparseSpMM(handle, opA, opB, alpha, matA, matB, beta, matC, computeType, alg, externalBuffer)

   Compute the sparse matrix multiplication with a dense matrix.

   ``hipsparseSpMM`` multiplies the scalar :math:`\alpha` with a sparse :math:`m \times k` matrix :math:`op(A)`,
   defined in CSR, CSC, COO, BSR, or Blocked ELL storage format, and the dense :math:`k \times n` matrix :math:`op(B)`
   and adds the result to the dense :math:`m \times n` matrix :math:`C` that is multiplied by the scalar
   :math:`\beta`, such that

   .. math::

      C := \alpha \cdot op(A) \cdot op(B) + \beta \cdot C,

   with

   .. math::

      op(A) = \left*    \begin{array}{ll}
          A,   & \text{if trans_A == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE} \\
          A^T, & \text{if trans_A == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_TRANSPOSE} \\
          A^H, & \text{if trans_A == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_CONJUGATE_TRANSPOSE}
      \end{array}
      \right.

   and

   .. math::

      op(B) = \left*    \begin{array}{ll}
          B,   & \text{if trans_B == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE} \\
          B^T, & \text{if trans_B == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_TRANSPOSE} \\
          B^H, & \text{if trans_B == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_CONJUGATE_TRANSPOSE}
      \end{array}
      \right.

   Par:
       <table>
       <caption id="spmm_uniform">Uniform Precisions</caption>
       <tr><th>A / B / C / compute_type
       <tr><td>HIP_R_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_R_64F
       <tr><td>HIP_C_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_C_64F
       </table>

   Par:
       <table>
       <caption id="spmm_mixed">Mixed Precisions</caption>
       <tr><th>A / B      <th>C         <th>compute_type
       <tr><td>HIP_R_8I   <td>HIP_R_32I <td>HIP_R_32I
       <tr><td>HIP_R_8I   <td>HIP_R_32F <td>HIP_R_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_R_16F  <td>HIP_R_32F <td>HIP_R_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_R_16F  <td>HIP_R_16F <td>HIP_R_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_R_16BF <td>HIP_R_32F <td>HIP_R_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_R_16BF <td>HIP_R_16BF <td>HIP_R_32F
       </table>

   ``hipsparseSpMM`` supports ``HIPSPARSE_INDEX_32I`` and ``HIPSPARSE_INDEX_64I`` index precisions
   for storing the row pointer and column indices arrays of the sparse matrices.

   ``hipsparseSpMM`` also supports batched computation for CSR, CSC, COO and Blocked ELL matrices. There are three supported batch modes:

   .. math::

      C_i = A \times B_i \\
      C_i = A_i \times B \\
      C_i = A_i \times B_i

   The batch mode is determined by the batch count and stride passed for each matrix. For example,
   to use the first batch mode (:math:`C_i = A \times B_i`) with 100 batches for non-transposed :math:`A`,
   :math:`B`, and :math:`C`, pass the following:

   .. math::

      batchCountA=1 \\
      batchCountB=100 \\
      batchCountC=100 \\
      offsetsBatchStrideA=0 \\
      columnsValuesBatchStrideA=0 \\
      batchStrideB=k*n \\
      batchStrideC=m*n

   To use the second batch mode (:math:`C_i = A_i \times B`), use these settings:

   .. math::

      batchCountA=100 \\
      batchCountB=1 \\
      batchCountC=100 \\
      offsetsBatchStrideA=m+1 \\
      columnsValuesBatchStrideA=nnz \\
      batchStrideB=0 \\
      batchStrideC=m*n

   And to use the third batch mode (:math:`C_i = A_i \times B_i`), pass these values:

   .. math::

      batchCountA=100 \\
      batchCountB=100 \\
      batchCountC=100 \\
      offsetsBatchStrideA=m+1 \\
      columnsValuesBatchStrideA=nnz \\
      batchStrideB=k*n \\
      batchStrideC=m*n

   Args:
       handle (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           handle to the hipSPARSE library context queue.

       opA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           matrix operation type.

       opB (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           matrix operation type.

       alpha (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\alpha`.

       matA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           matrix descriptor.

       matB (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           matrix descriptor.

       beta (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\beta`.

       matC (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           matrix descriptor.

       computeType (:py:obj:`~.hipDataType`) -- *IN*:
           floating point precision for the SpMM computation.

       alg (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMMAlg_t`) -- *IN*:
           SpMM algorithm for the SpMM computation.

       externalBuffer (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *OUT*:
           temporary storage buffer allocated by the user.

   Returns:
       A :py:obj:`~.tuple` of size 1 that contains (in that order):

       * :py:obj:`~.hipsparseStatus_t`: One of:
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_SUCCESS`: the operation completed successfully.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE`: ``handle,`` ``alpha,`` ``matA,`` ``matB,`` ``matC,`` ``beta,`` or
                 ``externalBuffer`` pointer is invalid.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED`: ``opA,`` ``opB,`` ``computeType,`` or ``alg`` is
                 currently not supported.

.. py:function:: hipsparseSpMV(handle, opA, alpha, matA, vecX, beta, vecY, computeType, alg, externalBuffer)

   Compute the sparse matrix multiplication with a dense vector.

   ``hipsparseSpMV`` multiplies the scalar :math:`\alpha` with a sparse :math:`m \times n` matrix :math:`op(A)`, defined in CSR,
   CSC, COO, COO (AoS), BSR, or SELL format, with the dense vector :math:`x` and adds the result to the dense vector :math:`y`
   that is multiplied by the scalar :math:`\beta`, such that

   .. math::

      y := \alpha \cdot op(A) \cdot x + \beta \cdot y,

   with

   .. math::

      op(A) = \left*    \begin{array}{ll}
          A,   & \text{if trans == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE} \\
          A^T, & \text{if trans == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_TRANSPOSE} \\
          A^H, & \text{if trans == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_CONJUGATE_TRANSPOSE}
      \end{array}
      \right.

       <tr><th>A         <th>X / Y / compute_type
       <tr><td>HIP_R_32F <td>HIP_C_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_R_64F <td>HIP_C_64F
       </table>

   ``hipsparseSpMV`` supports ``HIPSPARSE_INDEX_32I`` and ``HIPSPARSE_INDEX_64I`` index precisions
   for storing the row pointer and row/column indices arrays of the sparse matrices.

   Note:
       None of the algorithms above are deterministic when :math:`A` is transposed.

   Note:
       The sparse matrix formats currently supported are: ``HIPSPARSE_FORMAT_COO`` , ``HIPSPARSE_FORMAT_COO_AOS`` ,
       ``HIPSPARSE_FORMAT_CSR`` , ``HIPSPARSE_FORMAT_CSC`` , ``HIPSPARSE_FORMAT_BSR`` , and ``HIPSPARSE_FORMAT_SLICED_ELL`` .

   Note:
       Only the ``hipsparseSpMV_bufferSize`` and ``hipsparseSpMV`` routines are non-blocking and executed asynchronously
       with respect to the host. They can return before the actual computation has finished. The ``hipsparseSpMV_preprocess`` 
       routine is blocking with respect to the host.

   Note:
       Only the ``hipsparseSpMV_bufferSize`` and the ``hipsparseSpMV`` routines support execution in a hipGraph context.
       The ``hipsparseSpMV_preprocess`` stage does not support hipGraph.

   Args:
       handle (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           handle to the hipSPARSE library context queue.

       opA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           matrix operation type.

       alpha (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\alpha`.

       matA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           matrix descriptor.

       vecX (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           vector descriptor.

       beta (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\beta`.

       vecY (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *INOUT*:
           vector descriptor.

       computeType (:py:obj:`~.hipDataType`) -- *IN*:
           floating point precision for the SpMV computation.

       alg (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMVAlg_t`) -- *IN*:
           SpMV algorithm for the SpMV computation.

       externalBuffer (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *OUT*:
           temporary storage buffer allocated by the user.

   Returns:
       A :py:obj:`~.tuple` of size 1 that contains (in that order):

       * :py:obj:`~.hipsparseStatus_t`: One of:
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_SUCCESS`: the operation completed successfully.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE`: ``handle,`` ``alpha,`` ``matA,`` ``x,`` ``beta,`` ``y,`` or
                 ``externalBuffer`` pointer is invalid or if ``opA,`` ``computeType,`` ``alg`` is incorrect.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED`: ``computeType`` or ``alg`` is
                 currently not supported.

.. py:function:: hipsparseSpSM_solve(handle, opA, opB, alpha, matA, matB, matC, computeType, alg, spsmDescr, externalBuffer)

   Sparse triangular system solve

   ``hipsparseSpSM_solve`` solves a triangular linear system of equations defined by a sparse :math:`m \times m` square matrix :math:`op(A)`,
   given in CSR or COO storage format, such that

   .. math::

      op(A) \cdot C = \alpha \cdot op(B),

   with

   .. math::

      op(A) = \left*    \begin{array}{ll}
          A,   & \text{if opA == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE} \\
          A^T, & \text{if opB == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_TRANSPOSE}
      \end{array}
      \right.

   and

   .. math::

      op(B) = \left*    \begin{array}{ll}
          B,   & \text{if opA == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE} \\
          B^T, & \text{if opB == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_TRANSPOSE}
      \end{array}
      \right.

   Par:
       <table>
       <caption id="spsm_uniform">Uniform Precisions</caption>
       <tr><th>A / B / C / compute_type
       <tr><td>HIP_R_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_R_64F
       <tr><td>HIP_C_32F
       <tr><td>HIP_C_64F
       </table>

   Note:
       This routine does not correctly match the parameter list of the corresponding cuSPARSE API, ``cusparseSpSM_solve,``
       which does not take the external buffer parameter. hipSPARSE provides the alternate routine ``hipsparseSpSM_solve_ex`` , which
       correctly matches the parameter list of ``cusparseSpSM_solve.``

   Args:
       handle (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           handle to the hipSPARSE library context queue.

       opA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           matrix operation type for the sparse matrix :math:`A`.

       opB (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseOperation_t`) -- *IN*:
           matrix operation type for the dense matrix :math:`B`.

       alpha (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           scalar :math:`\alpha`.

       matA (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpMatDescr_st`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           sparse matrix descriptor.

       matB (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           dense matrix descriptor.

       matC (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *INOUT*:
           dense matrix descriptor.

       computeType (:py:obj:`~.hipDataType`) -- *IN*:
           floating point precision for the SpSM computation.

       alg (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpSMAlg_t`) -- *IN*:
           SpSM algorithm for the SpSM computation.

       spsmDescr (:py:obj:`~.hipsparseSpSMDescr`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *IN*:
           SpSM descriptor.

       externalBuffer (:py:obj:`~.rocm.bindings.util.types.Pointer`/:py:obj:`~.object`) -- *OUT*:
           temporary storage buffer allocated by the user.

   Returns:
       A :py:obj:`~.tuple` of size 1 that contains (in that order):

       * :py:obj:`~.hipsparseStatus_t`: One of:
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_SUCCESS`: the operation completed successfully.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE`: ``handle,`` ``alpha,`` ``matA,`` ``matB,`` ``matC,`` ``spsmDescr,`` or
                 ``externalBuffer`` pointer is invalid.
               - :py:obj:`~.HIPSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED`: ``opA,`` ``opB,`` ``computeType,`` or ``alg`` is
                 currently not supported.

   .. rubric:: C signature

   .. code-block:: c

       hipsparseStatus_t hipsparseSpSM_solve(hipsparseHandle_t handle, hipsparseOperation_t opA, hipsparseOperation_t opB, const void * alpha, hipsparseConstSpMatDescr_t matA, hipsparseConstDnMatDescr_t matB, const hipsparseDnMatDescr_t matC, hipDataType computeType, hipsparseSpSMAlg_t alg, hipsparseSpSMDescr_t spsmDescr, void * externalBuffer)

.. py:function:: hipsparseSpSV_solve(handle, opA, alpha, matA, x, y, computeType, alg, spsvDescr)

   Sparse triangular solve.

   ``hipsparseSpSV_solve`` solves a triangular linear system of equations defined by a sparse :math:`m \times m` square matrix
   :math:`op(A)`, given in CSR or COO storage format, such that

   .. math::

      op(A) \cdot y = \alpha \cdot x,

   with

   .. math::

      op(A) = \left*    \begin{array}{ll}
          A,   & \text{if trans == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE} \\
          A^T, & \text{if trans == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_TRANSPOSE}
      \end{array}
      \right.

.. py:function:: hipsparseSpVV(handle, opX, vecX, vecY, result, computeType, externalBuffer)

   Compute the inner dot product of a sparse vector with a dense vector.

   ``hipsparseSpVV`` computes the inner dot product of the sparse vector :math:`x` with the
   dense vector :math:`y`, such that

   .. math::

      \text{result} := op(x) \cdot y,

   with

   .. math::

      op(x) = \left*    \begin{array}{ll}
          x,   & \text{if trans == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE} \\
          \bar{x}, & \text{if trans == HIPSPARSE_OPERATION_CONJUGATE_TRANSPOSE} \\
      \end{array}
      \right.

   .. code-block::

      result = 0;
      for(i = 0; i < nnz; ++i)
      {
          result += x_val[i] * y[x_ind[i]];
      }
